tool_args.rationale: The pilot suggests sink suppression but does not establish whether slow adaptation eventually overwhelms the positive fast response. The slow-horizon probe directly tests that distinction before extrapolating to H = 20.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations have H ≤ 0.48. In this short window, slow adaptation mainly constrains the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant, not their separate effects at H = 20.
It omits the sink-gradient dependence suggested by the depressed responses at higher gradients.
Finer temporal sampling does not directly resolve the ambiguity at the target horizon.
It does not test slow adaptation or sink coupling.
